system.title: Thermostat basics
system.description: Choose equipment and optional outdoor/home sensors. Reaction, grouping, room protection, PID tuning and preset temperatures are also editable on the device page under Configuration. Set the comfort temperature on the thermostat card. Shadow mode observes without operating the relay.

data.name: Name
data.home_sensor: Home presence or zone person count
data.shadow: Shadow mode: observe without heater commands

manage.title: Rooms
manage.description: Add or edit room sensors and PID settings. Weekly schedules have their own configuration section.

room.title: Room sensors and PID
room.description: Choose room sensors and tuning. Auto can average similarly occupied rooms. Every source follows the single thermostat target. Room buffers and tuning entities are on the device page under Configuration.

schedules.title: Scheduling
schedules.description: Create weekly time blocks in Settings → Devices & services → Helpers → Schedule, then connect that helper here. Times remain editable in HA’s native weekly editor.

schedule.title: Connect a weekly Schedule helper
schedule.description: Temperatures use {temperature_unit}. A block start is the desired comfort arrival time when preheat is enabled. Optional block data can override temperature and source.

data.name: Schedule name
data.preheat: Warm up before a block starts
data.data_temperature_unit: Unit for optional temperature values in schedule block data

room_gains.title: Manual PID for {room}
room_gains.description: Leave the conservative defaults if unsure. Gains use Celsius internally, regardless of display units. Automatic tuning is available in the room settings.

advanced.title: Advanced settings
advanced.description: Defaults work without editing these pages.

presets.title: Away, Sleep and Boost
presets.description: These modes temporarily override the thermostat target. Temperatures use {temperature_unit}.

relay.title: Relay timing and safety
relay.description: Heat demand is a fraction of the PWM cycle. Minimum on/off times can stretch or combine pulses. Temperatures use {temperature_unit}.

average_pid.title: Average PID tuning
average_pid.description: Average mode has its own PID controller. Automatic tuning waits for validated heating observations.

average_gains.title: Manual Average PID gains
average_gains.description: Defaults are conservative. Gains use Celsius internally.

schedule_details.title: Advanced schedule settings
schedule_details.description: Optional settings for overlapping schedules and additional block data.

data.data_temperature_unit: Default unit for additional block data

error.heater_already_configured: This relay already belongs to another Comfort Sense Thermostat entry.
error.heater_missing: The selected heating switch does not exist.
error.invalid_room: Choose a unique room name, valid temperature sensors and PID tuning mode.
error.invalid_config: Check equipment, rooms and schedule bindings. Removed rooms must also be removed from schedule bindings; targets must be below the safety limit.
error.invalid_schedule: Choose an existing Schedule helper, a valid source and a target below the safety limit.
error.invalid_cycle: The PWM cycle must be at least the minimum on time plus minimum off time.
